findings.expected_vs_actual: Expected CI on doit/TASK-1.17 to be green; actual: CI run 44892551075 failed in the E2E step on one WebKit test (e2e/cards.spec.ts:215 logo 'not decoded' vs 'missing'). The failure is in code this task does not touch and passes 20/20 locally, so it looks like a flake.
findings.fix: No product change expected: re-run the failed CI job (or push the next commit) and confirm the CI workflow concludes success for the branch head. If it fails again, investigate the WebKit logo-decode check as a flaky test in a separate task.

findings.expected_vs_actual: Expected the tests to prove per-invariant counts are summed across shards; actual: every test case has each invariant id non-zero in only one shard, so a combine that took the maximum instead of the sum would still pass. The real behaviour does sum correctly (verified independently).
findings.fix: Optional: add a case where the same invariant id has non-zero counts in two shards and assert the sum.

summary: Implementation behaves as specified. The full million run passes (1,000,000 hands, 0 violations, 7.9 s) and two runs are byte-identical. Each shard section matches its direct re-run. Strict parsing rejects crashed, killed, odd-exit and mismatched shards with exit 1, the default checker is used, and per-invariant sums are correct. The workflow matches the spec. No tampering. The only blocker is SPEC-09: the branch CI run failed on an apparently flaky WebKit e2e test in untouched code. It needs a green CI re-run, not a code change.
